summary: Phase 3 Calculator Integration Testing Complete - Backend APIs working 100%, Calculator page functional but has React infinite re-render bug

ui_bugs.issue: React 'Maximum update depth exceeded' warning - useEffect infinite loop when onCalculate callback changes
ui_bugs.details: In MaterialCalculatorCard.tsx, the useEffect at line 378-380 calls handleCalculate which depends on onCalculate. When onCalculate is an inline function, it causes infinite re-renders. Fix: Use useRef for onCalculate or memoize the callback in parent components.

action_items: FIX: MaterialCalculatorCard.tsx infinite re-render issue - use useRef for onCalculate prop or change useEffect dependency
NOTE: To test raw material product page with calculator, a category must have categoryType='raw_material' (currently all categories are 'standard')
critical_code_review_comments: MaterialCalculatorCard.tsx line 348-380: handleCalculate callback has onCalculate in dependencies but useEffect at line 378 causes infinite re-renders when onCalculate is an inline function. Recommended fix: Use useRef to store onCalculate callback.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 3 calculator integration is complete. Raw material product pages need categoryType='raw_material' to show calculator.
